title: Anomalies
subtitle: Out-of-norm consumption events of the last 30 days, causes and losses

summary.lossNote: False alarms are excluded from the loss
summary.feedback: {count} false alarm reports sent to the AI model

timeline.aria: Anomaly timeline, last 30 days, {count} anomalies. Each line is one anomaly.
timeline.hint: The thin line spans the anomaly, thick parts are single events. Click a line for details.

detail.chartTitle: Consumption in that period with the optimal band
detail.noRec: No recommendation for this anomaly. An engineering check is recommended.
detail.falseNote: Feedback sent to the AI model. Thresholds of this rule will be re-evaluated for similar cases.
detail.falseHint: Marking a false alarm sends feedback to the AI model and refines future detections.
detail.commentsEmpty: No comments yet. Record the result of the check here.
detail.commentPlaceholder: For example: valve checked in the compressor room
detail.whyData: Hourly meter data, production schedule and outdoor temperature, last 30 days
detail.whyCompare: In the event hours actual {actual}, optimal {expected}
detail.notFound: This anomaly is no longer in the list
detail.notFoundBody: The detection window is 30 days. Older anomalies leave the list.

rule.idle_load: In a non-production hour the load exceeds the upper edge of the optimal band for at least {minHours} consecutive hours.
rule.baseload_trend: Night baseload between {from}:00 and {to}:00 rises by {pct} or more over a {days} day trend.
rule.spike: In a production hour the load rises above the model by more than z = {z}.
rule.peak_power: {count} or more machines start in the same hour with a high inrush.
rule.weather_mismatch: On a day with mean temperature below {temp} cooling runs above {load} of rated power.
rule.enpi_degradation: Weekly kWh per tonne is {pct} or more above the normalised model value.

explain.idle_load: {equipment} ran {occurrences} times in non-production hours, {hours} in total. Average load {avgKw} ({loadPct} of rated) while the optimal model expected {expectedKw}. Estimated loss: {loss}.
explain.baseload_trend: {equipment} night baseload has been rising for {days} days: from {refKw} to {currentKw} ({pct}). About {slope} more per day is a typical sign of a compressed air leak or wear. Estimated loss: {loss}.
explain.spike: {equipment} rose to {peakKw} around {time} while the optimal model expected {expectedKw}. Deviation z = {z}. Estimated loss: {loss}.
explain.peak_power: On average {count} machines were started at the same time around {hour}. Total plant power reached {peakKw}, peak limit {limitKw}, typical production hour {typicalKw}. Estimated loss: {loss}.
explain.weather_mismatch: On a cold day with mean temperature {temp}, {equipment} ran {hours} at {loadPct} of rated power. For this weather the optimal model expected {expectedKw}. Estimated loss: {loss}.
explain.enpi_degradation: Weekly EnPI was {enpi}, expected {expected} after normalising for production and weather. Deviation {pct}. Consumption above optimal: {loss}.
